description: Horaires prévus sur les lignes de transport en commun d'Ile-de-France (GTFS Datahub) is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ensemble de fichiers décrivant l'offre de transport (horaires, parcours, lignes, arrêts, correspondances entre arrêts) prévue sur les trois prochaines semaines, pour l'ensemble des lignes de transport en commun d'Ile-de-France (OPTILE RATP et SNCF). Ces fichiers sont mis à jour toutes les semaines. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Horaires, Train, Métro, RER, Tramway, Bus. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2024-03-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Mobilité (https://cloud.fabmob.io/s/eYWWJBdM3fQiFNm). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
